signals.name: live-success-percentage
signals.queryText:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/46433637-4539-481a-b054-e2c9f83ae51d/resourceGroups/rg-m365-demo/providers/Microsoft.Insights/components/appi-m365-experience-poc"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - 5m .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "synthetic.probe.runs"
| where tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live" and tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "exchange"
| summarize Total = sum(Sum),
            Successful = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "success"),
            Failed = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "failure"),
            Unexecutable = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "unexecutable")
| where Total > 0
| project Value = 100.0 * Successful / Total, Total, Successful, Failed, Unexecutable

signals.name: live-mean-latency
signals.queryText:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/46433637-4539-481a-b054-e2c9f83ae51d/resourceGroups/rg-m365-demo/providers/Microsoft.Insights/components/appi-m365-experience-poc"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - 5m .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "mailflow.delivery.duration"
| where tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live" and tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "exchange"
// Histograms contain a sum in seconds and an observation count, not raw percentiles.
| summarize DurationSeconds = sum(Sum), Samples = sum(ItemCount)
| where Samples > 0
| project Value = 1000.0 * DurationSeconds / Samples, Samples

signals.name: live-success-percentage
signals.queryText:
// Rendered by Bicep; all health queries share this exact live observation/coverage contract.
let ApplicationInsightsResourceId = '/subscriptions/46433637-4539-481a-b054-e2c9f83ae51d/resourceGroups/rg-m365-demo/providers/Microsoft.Insights/components/appi-m365-experience-poc';
let EvaluationTime = now();
let ExpectedTargets = datatable(Service:string, Cohort:string, ProbeId:string, IntervalSeconds:long, LookbackMinutes:long, GraceSeconds:long)
[
"exchange", "exchange-global", "exchange-probe-001", 60, 5, 180,
"sharepoint", "sharepoint-global", "sharepoint-probe-001", 300, 15, 180
];
let MaximumLookbackMinutes = toscalar(ExpectedTargets | summarize max(LookbackMinutes));
let Results =
    AppTraces
    | where _ResourceId =~ ApplicationInsightsResourceId
    | where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - MaximumLookbackMinutes * 1m .. EvaluationTime)
    | where Message == "synthetic-result"
    | where tostring(Properties["probe.schema_version"]) == "2.0"
    | where tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live"
    | extend
        ObservedAt = todatetime(Properties["probe.observed_at"]),
        Service = tostring(Properties["probe.service"]),
        Cohort = tostring(Properties["probe.cohort"]),
        ProbeId = tostring(Properties["probe.id"]),
        CorrelationId = tostring(Properties["probe.correlation_id"]),
        Outcome = tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]),
        DurationMs = todouble(Properties["probe.duration_ms"]),
        DeliveryDurationMs = todouble(Properties["probe.delivery_duration_ms"])
    | where isnotempty(CorrelationId)
    | where Outcome in ("success", "failure", "unexecutable")
    | join kind=inner ExpectedTargets on Service, Cohort, ProbeId
    | where ObservedAt between (EvaluationTime - LookbackMinutes * 1m .. EvaluationTime)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Service, Cohort, ProbeId, CorrelationId;
let Coverage =
    ExpectedTargets
    | join kind=leftouter (
        Results
        | summarize Attempts = count(), Unexecutable = countif(Outcome == "unexecutable"),
                    LastObservedAt = max(ObservedAt) by Service, Cohort, ProbeId
    ) on Service, Cohort, ProbeId
    | extend MaximumAgeSeconds = IntervalSeconds + GraceSeconds
    | extend Fresh = isnotnull(LastObservedAt)
        and LastObservedAt >= EvaluationTime - MaximumAgeSeconds * 1s
    | project Service, Cohort, ProbeId, IntervalSeconds, LookbackMinutes, MaximumAgeSeconds,
              Attempts = coalesce(Attempts, long(0)), Unexecutable = coalesce(Unexecutable, long(0)),
              LastObservedAt, Fresh;

let CompleteCoverage = toscalar(Coverage | where Cohort == "exchange-global" | summarize countif(not(Fresh)) == 0);
Results
| where Cohort == "exchange-global"
| summarize Attempts = count(), Successful = countif(Outcome == "success"),
            Failed = countif(Outcome == "failure"), Unexecutable = countif(Outcome == "unexecutable"),
            LastObservedAt = max(ObservedAt)
// Never turn an empty or stale journey into 100% (or 0%) service health.
| where CompleteCoverage and Attempts > 0
| project Value = 100.0 * Successful / Attempts, Attempts, Successful, Failed, Unexecutable, LastObservedAt

signals.displayName: Services without recent live run metrics
signals.name: missing-live-services
signals.queryText:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/46433637-4539-481a-b054-e2c9f83ae51d/resourceGroups/rg-m365-demo/providers/Microsoft.Insights/components/appi-m365-experience-poc"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - 15m .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "synthetic.probe.runs" and tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live"
| summarize ExchangeRuns = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "exchange" and TimeGenerated >= EvaluationTime - 3m),
            SharePointRuns = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "sharepoint" and TimeGenerated >= EvaluationTime - 11m)
| project Value = iff(ExchangeRuns > 0, 0, 1) + iff(SharePointRuns > 0, 0, 1), ExchangeRuns, SharePointRuns
